write_up: You moved from tutoring ninth graders to managing a summer jobs program and supervising staff. A recruiter can follow that progression, but can't tell how many students the program places or what happened for them.

The summer jobs line is your best model: it names the program, the students and the employers. Add its size and any results you can verify, then give the same treatment to partner recruitment and Salesforce tracking.
